<cat>gameevent</cat>
<title>show_freezepanel</title>

<structure>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<description>
		Called when the freeze cam is started.  
		Example cause:
```
Player:Spectate(OBS_MODE_FREEZECAM)
```
	</description>
	<fields>
		<item type="number" name="killer">The Index of the Entity that is being spectated or `0`.</item>
	</fields>
</structure>

# Examples
<example>
	<description>This is a basic template with the purpose of including all arguments / table variables to make it easily known which values can be accessed.</description>
	<code>
gameevent.Listen( "show_freezepanel" )
hook.Add( "show_freezepanel", "show_freezepanel_example", function( data )
	local killer = data.killer	// The Map name.

	// Called when the freeze cam is started.
end )
	</code>
</example>
